name: Strike the Hand (Combat)
body:
You use the immense power of your strike to disable your opponent’s hand.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When using Power Attack, if the damage is more than half of the creatures remaining hit points, they suffer the effects of a called shot to the hand.

Normal: A called shot to the hand requires an attack with a -5 attack penalty.
